goal: Protect external signer (hardware wallet) users from a compromised or buggy signer altering their transaction
Prevents a signer from silently changing outputs or signing with an unsafe sighash type
Also fixes a combinepsbt bug that could make a valid PSBT unfinalizable
reviewability: Paused waiting on author: a reviewer found the hardening can be bypassed via a finalized PSBT response
No author reply in 8 days, so reviewing the current logic risks being invalidated by a fix
agreement: Concept ACK given, but same reviewer then found a real security gap in the hardening (jeanpablojp)
Unaddressed objection: finalized PSBT responses can bypass the new unsafe-sighash-type check, no author reply (jeanpablojp)
Also raised: unclear failure path when a signer returns a differently-versioned PSBT (jeanpablojp)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it closes a real fund-safety gap for external-signer users where a malicious or buggy signer could alter a transaction after signing
Also fixes a real combinepsbt bug that could silently drop sighash type and make a valid PSBT unfinalizable
Impact is bounded to external-signer users, and review found the current hardening incomplete
